about.text_html:
I’m traveling in search of myself and a place to call home. I pour my heart into my creative work and share a piece of myself with the world
My dream is to make a living doing what I love and to find peace in a safe place - somewhere I’ll finally feel at home

If you’d like to support me and my little creative world, you can leave a donation🌈 here
